subject: English
passage: The Viking Mars missions (1975-1982) sent seismic sensors and weather instruments to monitor Martian geological activity and produced substantial amounts of data, much of which was stored on magnetic tape formats that are now obsolete. A data-recovery project is working to ______ these data so that the information is available to researcher Dr. Sofia Morales, who is analyzing patterns in Martian seismic activity.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of the data-recovery project. In this context, 'salvage' means to rescue or recover something valuable from potential loss or destruction. The text indicates that Viking mission data is stored on 'magnetic tape formats that are now obsolete,' meaning the information is at risk of becoming permanently inaccessible. The purpose of the data-recovery project is to extract this valuable scientific information from obsolete storage media and transfer it to modern accessible formats so that Dr. Morales can use it in her research on Martian seismic activity.
